about: Facts from the illustrated examples of Roberson's Winning 42 (6th edition), read from the owner's reviewed transcription (winning42-archive, branch main, commit 664ea8dd). Anchors name capture files (shot-NNNN). No book text is reproduced; notes are ours.

notation.tile: a-b with 0 for blank, in printed order: top then bottom for a vertical tile, left then right for a horizontal one
notation.roles: bidder, opponent-1 (the seat after the bidder), partner, opponent-2; play runs in that order
notation.declaration: P0..P6 a pip suit, DT doubles, NT no trump, nello and sevens as named; null when the book does not state it
notation.bid: the number the book recommends or the deal is played at; pass; null when not stated. 84 is two marks and needs all 42 points
notation.annotations: the small printed number beside a tile, parallel to tiles; null when none
notation.lines: plays in narrated order; a null tile or seat is one the prose does not name; 'setter' is an opponent the prose does not identify; a trick's winner and points are given only where the prose states or shows them; a tail is the rest of the deal, claimed by one side
